message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are performed on any incoming data or arguments in the visible code.
No detected untrusted source handling: The code does not fetch data from any remote source, and no checksum verification or authentication mechanisms are present.

No detected label flipping detection: No code in any of the pipeline files checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is implemented anywhere in the visible data preparation or training code.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads model weights via paths (best_state.pt, last_state.pt, model_state_*.pt) without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before loading.
No detected label distribution validation: No code in the training path checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distributions before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation-clustering, gradient-anomaly, or any other backdoor/trigger detection mechanism anywhere in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: No DP libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanisms are imported or used in the training pipeline.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Multiple metrics (EER, minDCF, ROC) are computed, but there is no isolation mechanism for the test set, no hashing/signing of evaluation data, and no evidence preventing the evaluation list from overlapping with training data.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path loads data via evaluateFromList and processes audio frames without any visible shape, range, or schema validation on incoming inputs.

No detected output bounds checks: Scores and labels returned by evaluateFromList are passed directly to threshold-tuning and DCF computation functions with no NaN guards or probability sanity bounds checks visible in the code.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a speaker verification model processing audio, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
